title: Frosted Items
description: This is a resource pack that makes 11  items in a new style! The style of this resource pack is Frosted (icy, frozen…). You can change the style by renaming the Items included to be able to change to a specific name in the description
body:
# ❄️ Frosted Resource Pack❄️ 
The Frosted Resource Pack
Transform your gear with the Frosted Resource Pack! Rename specific items at an anvil to unlock unique icy, frosted textures — making your equipment stand out from the rest.

## ✨ How It Works
Simply rename any supported item at an anvil to unlock its frosted appearance. Each item has its own unique frosted skin, and some items even have custom in-hand models!

## 🗡️ Weapons & Tools
The Netherite Sword can be renamed to either Frosted Sword to wield the legendary Frostslayer, or Frosted Scythe to transform it into a deadly scythe. The Netherite Axe and Netherite Pickaxe can be renamed to Frosted Axe and Frosted Pickaxe respectively to apply their icy textures. The Netherite Spear can be renamed to Frosted Spear which features a fully custom in-hand model so it looks great both in your inventory and while held. The Bow can be renamed to Frosted Bow for a fully animated frosted pulling texture across all three pull stages. The Mace can be renamed to Frosted Mace for a chilling new look.

## 🛡️ Equipment
Rename your Elytra to Frosted Wings to equip a stunning set of icy wings that show a custom texture while worn on your back.

## 🍎 Consumables
The Golden Apple and Golden Carrot are automatically reskinned to their frosted variants — no renaming needed!

## 💀 Totem of Undying
The Totem of Undying defaults to the Frosted Totem texture automatically. If you prefer the vanilla look, simply rename it to Totem of Undying to revert it back to the original texture.

## 📦 Requirements & Installation
This pack requires Minecraft 1.21.5 or higher and works with no mods — just a vanilla resource pack! To install, download the .zip file, place it in your resourcepacks folder, and enable it in Options → Resource Packs.

Made by ❄️Frxxsty117
